verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own docs state that developers can integrate with its products using official Airwallex SDKs, so the capability is first-party and direct. However, the evidence is a single one-line mention that gives no detail on which languages or platforms are covered or how deep the SDKs go. Missing for 10: the list of supported SDK languages and platforms, SDK reference documentation or repositories, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Quickly and securely integrate with Airwallex products using Airwallex SDKs
